centring.datum: paired stadium stand fronts / roof opening; excludes annexes

google_overhead_review.review: Corrected the northern/top roof edge: the crown is now on the pitch's long centreline, removing the previous 6.5 m model offset. Two broad native curves give the north shoulders an even sweep, with matching tangent and curvature at the crown instead of the former pinched bend. Roof bays meet the revised boundary. The pitch, southern expanded end, main roof band and eight occluded access-tower caps are retained. Google shows an earlier North Stand phase; this drawing does not certify the completed 2026 extension.

google_overhead_review.limitations: Visually reviewed simplified main features, not a measured as-built survey or every roof panel. Elevated roofs can be displaced by parallax. Some views show older redevelopment stages; see individual review.
google_overhead_review.usage: Private comparison only. Original Google screenshots retain attribution. No reference bitmap is embedded in plot artwork; this is not a licence to redistribute imagery.
